`final class JarCheck`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.jar` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [JarCheck.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/jar/JarCheck.java)

Starts JOID from a packaged jar, opens a UI, draws 60 frames and exits with the result, for the jar checks of a backend.

## Description

Call it from a main of your own, run on a packaged jar with its libraries, to check that the jar starts JOID in the modes of its variant.

## Method details

<a id="JarCheck-method-run"></a>

### run

`void run(String variant, Supplier<Backend> register, Runnable present)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The … jar threw while it drew …, see the stack traces above

Registers the backend that the supplier returns, checks that the dev and demo modes match the variant (`prod`, `dev` or `demo`), opens a UI (a demo for `demo`), draws 60 frames with a present after each, and exits with `0`.
Exits with `1` when the modes do not match, when a stack trace reaches the error stream, or when the UI closes.
